content: Torn-write / crash-consistency pattern for mmap-backed stores: compute and store a checksum over each record/log-buffer segment; on recovery, recompute and compare -- mismatch means the write was torn and that segment is discarded/truncated back to last-good boundary. Known pitfall: MAP_SHARED plus msync can expose partially-flushed pages to concurrent readers (a verify-read can see a mix of old/new bytes) because flushing is page-granular, not atomic across the whole mapped region.
